g.text: S How global Batch8 becomes two independent per-device dynamic batches
P / D are request phase labels. The GQA grid identifies the total sequence count in the physical mixed batch.
Both ranks have observed local B=1,2,3,4 launches. No line interpolates unobserved scheduler states or asserts full-step coverage.
The R06/R07 B4 decode launches use the official packed path; the optimized B1-B3 packed path has no observed hit.
